import bisect
n,m = map(int,input().split())
a = [int(x) for x in input().split()]
b = []
otv = 0
for i in range(0,1<<(n//2 + n%2)):
    t = 0
    k = i
    for j in range(20):
        if k & 1:
            t += a[j]
        k = k >> 1
    b.append(t%m)
b.sort()       
for i in range(0,1<<(n//2)):
    t = 0
    k = i
    for j in range(20):
        if k & 1:
            t += a[(n//2 + n%2) + j]
        k = k >> 1
    t = t % m
    k = bisect.bisect_left(b,m - t - 1)
    if k < len(b):
        t2 = b[k]
        if t2 > m - t - 1:
            if k - 1 >= 0:
                t2 = b[k - 1]
    else:
        t2 = b[-1]
    otv = max(otv,(t + t2)%m,(t + b[-1])%m)
print(otv % m)
